newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia Airlines sees H1 profit around $0.5 mln.
newsitem.headline: Croatia Airlines sees H1 profit around $0.5 mln.

text.p: Croatian flag carrier Croatia Airlines d.d. said on Wednesday first half operating profit could total almost $0.5 million after costs were deducted.
Thanks to a strong passenger and cargo increase in the first six months, total turnover topped $50 million.
"Of this, 89 percent was accounted for by regular traffic," the company said in a press release.

January-June passenger traffic rose 11 percent from the year-ago period. The passenger load factor (PLF) was up 6.3 points to 53.9 percent. The airline said it was one of the biggest leaps among a number of European and world carriers.
It carried 2,412 tonnes of cargo and mail, or 5.9 percent more than in the first six months last year.
Productivity, measured by tonne-kilometres per employee, also increased 3.6 percent. The company employs 630 people and has a fleet of nine planes, which it plans to replace.
Croatia Airlines made no estimate of full-year earnings. Due to a 1995 traffic slump it made a $3.4 million net loss. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
